email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the User Acquisition Manager | Brainer role at Jobgether's partner company. With a technical background in digital marketing and hands-on experience in paid acquisition, I'm excited about the opportunity to drive growth for a platform focused on cognitive development.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage SEO and content for client websites, but my broader skill set includes Google Ads and analytics. I've also built and optimized websites for various clients, using data to improve performance. While my CV highlights SEO and web development, I've consistently worked with performance metrics and A/B testing to enhance campaign results.

I'm eager to bring my analytical mindset and proactive approach to your team, focusing on Meta Ads and exploring new channels to scale user acquisition sustainably. I'm confident in my ability to collaborate with creative and analytics teams to turn insights into actionable growth strategies.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your mission.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the User Acquisition Manager | Brainer position at Jobgether's partner company, as advertised. With a strong foundation in digital marketing and a passion for data-driven growth, I am eager to contribute to the success of your cognitive development platform.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation for client websites, utilizing tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to track and improve performance. While my primary focus has been organic growth, I have also gained experience with Google Ads and have a solid understanding of key performance metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and CVR. My technical background, including front-end development and Python automation, enables me to approach campaign optimization with a analytical and systematic mindset.

I have successfully managed multiple projects, from building and optimizing websites for clients like mirook.com and majistraleczacilari.org.tr to running SEO audits that measurably improved search health scores. These experiences have honed my ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and collaborate with teams to achieve measurable results. I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines my analytical skills with creative testing and experimentation—areas where I thrive.

While my CV emphasizes SEO and web development, I am confident in my ability to quickly master Meta Ads and other paid channels. I am proactive, results-oriented, and eager to experiment with new strategies to drive sustainable user acquisition. I am excited about the opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment and contribute to a product that helps people develop their cognitive abilities.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Hands-on experience with Google Ads and analytics tools (Google Analytics, Search Console) for tracking performance metrics.
• Proven ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks, as shown in freelance and agency roles.
• Technical background in front-end development and Python automation, enabling data-driven decision-making.
• Experience with A/B testing and optimization through SEO audits and website performance improvements.
• Collaborative work with creative teams to develop content and optimize for search and user engagement.
